name: Product discovery / grilling
description: Grill the brief, review the specification and test seams, then review tracer-bullet tickets before PMT publication.

develop_brief.instructions: Develop or revise the product brief from the task, project instructions, recorded answers and Architect challenges. Resolve what the supplied intent establishes; identify genuine missing user decisions. Return brief_ready with the developed brief.

challenge.instructions: Apply grill-with-docs and codebase-design to challenge the brief with concrete scenarios, constraints and test seams. Return needs_revision for incomplete reasoning, needs_user for unresolved user decisions, or brief_agreed when discovery is settled. Specification synthesis is a separate assignment.

specify.instructions: Apply to-spec: synthesize agreed discovery into a specification with behavior, boundaries, decisions, acceptance criteria and high-level test seams. Preserve glossary/ADR proposals in the document. Return needs_revision if a requested change reopens product discovery; needs_user for a concrete unresolved decision; otherwise specification_ready. The user reviews the specification and seams next.

review_specification.instructions: Review the specification, scope and proposed test seams. Approve to plan tickets, or request changes.

await_user.instructions: The team needs your decisions before continuing.

create_tickets.instructions: Apply to-tickets: draft self-contained tracer-bullet vertical slices with observable acceptance criteria, verification and real blocking edges. Preserve the approved scope. Ask needs_user for missing product decisions; needs_revision if the specification must change. Return tickets_ready with a reviewable breakdown and plan {epic:{title,description},tickets:[{title,description,acceptanceCriteria,dependsOn}]}. dependsOn contains zero-based indexes of earlier tickets. The user reviews before publication.

review_tickets.instructions: Review the ticket breakdown, slice size and blocking dependencies. Approve publication to PMT, or request changes.

complete.message: Specification, epic and tickets are ready for your review. Start delivery separately when ready.

name: Epic delivery
description: Dependency-ready tickets pass BA, TDD and independent review; the assembled candidate passes acceptance before a retrospective.

triage.instructions: Assess this ticket against the epic goal and hand it to the BA for readiness verification.

refine.instructions: Verify scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies and verification readiness before implementation.

build.instructions: Apply implement/tdd at the accepted seams: establish a failing behavior test, implement the minimum green slice, preserve predecessor behavior and run the required checks. Report commands/results and limitations. Supply meaningful verification for a new project. The runner schedules independent review.

review.instructions: Apply code-review to the exact verified candidate. Report Standards and Spec verdicts separately, with actionable findings and regression evidence. Approve only when acceptance criteria and preserved earlier behavior pass. The runner owns any separate review assignments.

resolve_technical.instructions: Resolve the routine technical blocker within current scope. Escalate product/authority decisions or exhausted recovery to the user.

await_resolution.instructions: The ticket needs your resolution before continuing.

acceptance.instructions: Exercise the assembled epic's user-visible acceptance criteria against the supplied exact candidate. Use the available project tools and verification receipts; report passed, failed or unverified criteria with evidence. Return acceptance_passed only when all assigned criteria pass, changes for reproducible defects, or blocked for missing tools/environment. Keep source unchanged.

await_acceptance.instructions: Acceptance needs an environment or capability resolution. Answer to retry acceptance; a response alone does not pass it.

retrospective.instructions: Apply retro to the supplied primary execution evidence. Propose evidence-backed improvements to navigation, deterministic checks, review standards and agent instructions. Return retrospective_ready with recommendations, or an explicit no-change conclusion. Keep proposals distinct from adopted changes.

resolve_delivery.instructions: Resolve the repeated acceptance or retrospective command failure from its retained receipts within current scope. Work read-only against the exact delivered candidate. Return resolved with an actionable resolution for the saved state, or blocked with a concrete user question for missing capabilities or authority. Source changes require a separately reviewed Builder repair.

await_delivery_resolution.instructions: Workflow-level Lead recovery needs your resolution. The answer retries the saved state without passing acceptance automatically.

complete.message: Every ticket passed verification and independent review. The assembled candidate passed acceptance and its retrospective is ready. Integration remains separate.

name: Epic delivery with parallel worktrees
description: Dependency-ready tickets use isolated Git worktrees, pass independent review, and join a Lead-approved integration candidate. Final acceptance and retrospective precede uncommitted publication to the project folder.

await_tickets.instructions: Ticket workflows need direction. Open their tasks for specific questions or provide direction here for the blocked ticket workflows.

integrate.instructions: Own integration of the independently reviewed ticket worktrees. Inspect the combined candidate and predecessor diff, all supplied ticket scope, and actual independent verification receipts. Return integrated only if the combined behavior and preservation are sound. Use changes for a concrete defect; the configured ticket team will repair and independently review the whole combined scope. Use technical_blocker for an environment/capability blocker. Keep source read-only; the runner applies approved Git integration.

Return retrospective_ready with recommendations, or an explicit no-change conclusion. Keep proposals distinct from adopted changes.

Return resolved with an actionable resolution for the saved state, or blocked with a concrete user question for missing capabilities or authority. Source changes require a separately reviewed Builder repair.

await_delivery_resolution.instructions: Workflow-level Lead recovery needs your resolution. The answer retries the saved state without passing acceptance automatically.

await_publication.instructions: Project files changed or could not be written. Resolve the named conflicts, then retry. Existing edits are preserved; the runner does not force an overwrite.

complete.message: Ticket worktrees passed review and Lead integration. Final acceptance passed, and accepted source is in the configured project folder as uncommitted changes.

name: Qualified ticket
description: Ready work proceeds to implementation; BA clarifies gaps. Separate Spec and Standards reviewers approve the exact candidate.

triage.instructions: Judge concrete scope, accepted dependencies, owned paths and executable acceptance. Route ready work directly to Builder with a concise implementation direction. Use BA refinement only for missing scope or acceptance; product ambiguity is a real blocker. Preserve the approved ticket boundary.

Report commands/results and limitations. Supply meaningful verification for a new project. The runner schedules independent review.

review.instructions: Independently inspect the exact verified candidate against project standards, sole ownership and relevant regressions. This assignment records Standards; the Spec verdict is separate. Report concrete findings and preserve scope.
review.label: Standards review

review_spec.instructions: Independently compare the exact verified candidate with agreed behavior, exclusions and acceptance criteria. This assignment is Spec review, using approved/changes outcomes. Cite concrete source/test evidence. The Standards assignment is separate.
